approach: Add athena-core/src/code_health.rs with pure, fixture-testable functions and Athena entry points. measure() reads the working tree at the repository root (the checkout the Athena instance runs in; in land_pr it runs after resync_onto_merge so the tree matches the merge; in note_finished it reads the same working tree — one rule for both hooks), walks crates/**/*.rs, parses with syn (full+visit, proc-macro2 span-locations), counts production lines (non-blank, non-comment lines outside #[cfg(test)] item spans), finds the longest fn, and joins to records for 7-day landings and citations. Test run time comes from the 'test' check of the latest landed verification (unknown if absent). evaluate() uses constants: lines>2000; fn>200; lines>1500 with >=5 weekly landings. Athena::run_code_health(ui) queues one structural-pass request per breaching file unless an open request has the marker 'Structural pass: <path>', then a high-priority design review when >=10 landings since the last review request (first-ever baseline stored in a state-dir file). Hooks: Athena::note_finished (steward.rs; tick untouched) and the Landed-only block of land_pr (gh.rs). The hook never returns an error: failures become ui lines. Both hook tests live in a code_health::hooks test module so the filter matches.

demonstrations.method: Unit test with tempdir fixture .rs (known fn lengths plus a #[cfg(test)] mod) and in-memory JobRecords (landings inside/outside 7 days, rejected jobs, a finding naming the path).
demonstrations.observes: Exact production lines excluding test module, exact longest fn, 7-day landings (old excluded), citation count; at least 1 test run.
demonstrations.fails_without: Lines include the test module, longest fn wrong, landings and citations zero.

demonstrations.method: Fixtures: 2001-line file; 201-line fn; 1501 lines with 5 landings and with 4; small file.
demonstrations.observes: Each breach reported with its reason; small file and 4-landing case not flagged.
demonstrations.fails_without: A missing threshold leaves its breach unreported, or an under-threshold file is flagged.

demonstrations.method: Scratch repo with a breaching file; run_code_health twice, then with an open request, then with a closed one.
demonstrations.observes: Exactly one request naming file and numbers; repeat and open-request runs queue none; closed does not block.
demonstrations.fails_without: No dedup gives duplicates; no queueing gives none.

demonstrations.method: Records with a prior review request then 9 and 10 landed jobs; run check each time.
demonstrations.observes: None after 9; exactly one at Priority::High after 10; none added while open.
demonstrations.fails_without: Wrong cadence fires at the wrong count or lower priority.

demonstrations.method: Read the queued review text in a test.
demonstrations.observes: Text names code-health table, most changed and most broken files since last review, open structural-pass requests, recent rejections and planning stops, and a short design note with proposed changes as a design-only job.
demonstrations.fails_without: Text lacks what to review or produce.

demonstrations.method: Records with 25 landings and no review request; check, then 9 more landings, then the 10th.
demonstrations.observes: First check queues nothing and writes the baseline; review fires only 10 landings after.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the baseline, existing history queues a review at once.

demonstrations.method: Two tests in a code_health::hooks module: (a) drives the real Athena::land_pr Landed branch using a github.com-style origin URL and a fake Runner (following PagesFake in crates/athena-cli/tests/external_calls.rs or the gh.rs FakeRunner), with a breaching Rust file in the tree; (b) drives Athena::note_finished likewise. Each asserts the 'code health:' ui line and a structural-pass request. Producer confirms each fails with its hook call removed. The run must report exactly 2 passed for the filter; 0 tests run counts as failure.
demonstrations.observes: 2 tests passed: hooks::land_pr_runs_code_health and hooks::note_finished_runs_code_health; ui line and request present after each path.
demonstrations.fails_without: Removing the hook call from land_pr or note_finished removes the ui line and request, failing that test.

demonstrations.method: display.rs test builds StatusView with CodeHealth (two files, one over, test run time) and renders display::status; core test that Athena::status fills the field.
demonstrations.observes: Output has each file's lines, longest fn, weekly landings, citations, thresholds, over marker, test run time; zero files says none measured. Expect at least 1 test run.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the field and renderer the table text is absent.

demonstrations.method: Run the three checks Athena runs.
demonstrations.command: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked
demonstrations.observes: All exit 0 with the new tests listed passing.
demonstrations.fails_without: Unformatted code, any warning, or any failing test makes the command exit nonzero.

demonstrations.method: Read the diff of the two files.
demonstrations.observes: CHANGELOG Unreleased entry; decisions.md entry with the three thresholds, syn-vs-scan call, 10-landing cadence, baseline rule and the resync-skip note.
